QuestInfo.name: Rage of the Dragon
QuestInfo.0: #p2400005# and #p2400006# head to #b#m321100000##k when they learn that the Goddess's relic takes precedence over the Goddess Teardrops. But the scene they find is dark and troubled, and only #b#p2411000##k seems to know why.
QuestInfo.1: #p2411000#'s town has been besieged by a savage dragon! The great Onyx Dragon, Afrien, could be of help, if only a warrior strong enough to make it through the #bdungeon portal#k to #b#MDmap321190200##k were around.
QuestInfo.2: When they arrived in Afrien's cave, they found the great beast asleep! But Afrien's only child, #p2411009#, was there to greet them. He spoke of an evil dragon named Horntail, and the duo realized their journey was just beginning.
